summary: IDS feed s098_single is degraded: 86.5% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance, blinding payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 86.5% of traffic is TLS-encrypted and delivered to IDS without prior decryption. IDS needs full payload for signature matching but modern TLS 1.3/PFS is opaque without keys or intercept, so payload is not inspectable.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to ~86% of payloads - cannot match signatures for exploits, malware, C2 or lateral movement. Detection coverage severely reduced despite healthy delivery (no drops/overload/one-way issues).

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires cleartext payload; decrypt via packet broker integrated TLS decryption (key sharing or active proxy) or selectively forward only decryptable traffic to this IDS and send encrypted flows to a tool that tolerates encryption. Without decryption, IDS cannot improve coverage.
